prerequisites: Basic technical competencies acquired in mathematics, programming, and electrical engineering modules of the first semester are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can differentiate between various subject areas of electrical engineering and explain their focal points using examples.
Students apply the knowledge acquired so far in their studies independently. They are able to identify and apply the relevant fundamentals for the respective task.
Students can evaluate solution approaches for the chosen task area and select suitable approaches with justification.
Students can present their work results in a clearly structured form.
Students develop their professional interests further, classify them, and are able to contextualize them with regard to their studies.

syllabus_topics: Technical learning content from electrical engineering for first-year students according to changing tasks
Documentation and presentation of work results
assessment_rules: The graded examination performance consists of a project report of approximately 15-20 pages and an explanation of the project lasting approximately 15 minutes.
